name: Exit sign luminaire plan mark
summary: Plan mark for an illuminated exit or escape route sign, with an arrow showing the direction of travel.
description: Exit signs are drawn as a rectangle or luminaire mark with an arrow or EXIT text and, where relevant, the direction arrow that will appear on the sign face. Their position is set by the escape route design and they are usually maintained emergency luminaires.

The plan should show mounting (ceiling-hung, wall or projecting), whether single- or double-sided, and the arrow direction. Errors in arrow direction are a common defect found at inspection. The symbol does not give the viewing distance or legend type. Local regulations determine pictogram style.
readingNotes: Check arrow direction matches the escape route.
distinction: An emergency luminaire lights the escape route; an exit sign identifies the route and direction.
